SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND t.relname = 'dev_jobs' AND c.conname = 'dev_jobs_source_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) LIKE '%''plugin''%')
